0a7b4e55ab8a4139.description: **Company Overview:** TechUp Labs is looking for an AI-First Full Stack Marketer — someone who lives and breathes marketing through the lens of artificial intelligence. Ability to design and execute data-driven growth experiments using AI insights. 8. Excellent communication, storytelling, and creative problem-solving skills. 9. Comfortable in a fast-paced, experimental, and remote-first environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** 1. Experience building or managing AI-assisted marketing campaigns or SaaS growth funnels. 2. Familiarity with prompt engineering and optimizing AI-generated marketing outputs. 3. Experience integrating AI APIs or automation flows for lead generation and campaign optimization. 4. Exposure to data analytics platforms (Google Analytics 4, Mixpanel, Amplitude). 5. Experience using A/B testing and personalization tools powered by AI. 6. Understanding of marketing attribution models and customer journey mapping. 7. Creative eye for visual storytelling and brand design using generative tools. 8. About You: You’re a creative marketer who thinks like a growth hacker and operates like a data scientist — but with AI as your co-pilot. You see marketing as a playground for automation, personalization, and intelligent experimentation. You don’t just use AI tools — you orchestrate them to amplify creativity, efficiency, and impact. You love turning insights into action and data into stories that move people. **Benefits:** 1. Remote-friendly role with flexible working hours. 2. AI-first marketing culture that rewards innovation and experimentation. 3. Access to premium AI tools and automation platforms. 4. Continuous learning opportunities in AI-driven growth and marketing technology. 5. A supportive, creative, and growth-oriented environment. **How to Apply**: Send us your resume and a short note on how you’ve leveraged AI in marketing — for campaigns, automation, or content creation. Include examples, case studies, or links that demonstrate your AI-first marketing mi Additional Notes: We’re committed to inclusive and innovative hiring. If you’re curious, creative, and passionate about blending AI with marketing — we want to hear from you. Next Steps: Qualified candidates will be contacted for an initial interview. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to further interviews focusing on technical capability, as well as team fit. We look forward to seeing your application and welcoming skilled AI Marketing to our growing team! **P.S.Our BYOD(Bring Your Own Device) policy applies here too. 0a07436234a8b52e.description: Location: India, Remote Type: Full-time Team: AI / Engineering About hpy hpy is building AI that understands people, not just language. Most of todays AI systems are remarkably good at understanding what someone said. They are considerably less capable of understanding how someone is feeling, why their emotional state is changing, and what kind of interaction might actually improve their wellbeing. We think that distinction matters. Human wellbeing is influenced by patterns that unfold over time: emotion, behavior, relationships, environment, physiology, meaning and context. Todays models see fragments of this picture. We want to help them understand more of it. We started in behavioral health, building technology that understands conversations, identifies emotional signals, synthesizes longitudinal context and helps professionals better understand the people they serve. But behavioral health is our starting point, not the boundary of what were building. We are exploring the intersection of AI, emotion and human wellbeing and how hpys underlying intelligence can extend into entirely new products and verticals. The question were interested in is: What becomes possible when AI can understand not only what a person is doing, but how they are doing Were looking for an exceptional India-based engineer to help us answer that question. The role This is a hybrid engineering and applied research role. You will work closely with hpys founder and our partners to extend hpys core intelligence into new products and verticals. You should be comfortable moving across the entire stack: building an interface, designing the backend, constructing the AI pipeline behind it, evaluating a new model and putting the resulting product in front of a partner. Some projects will begin with a customer problem. Others may begin with a new research paper, model or capability that makes something possible that wasnt possible six months ago. We expect you to be paying attention to both. What youll work on You will: Extend hpys emotion and context intelligence into new wellbeing verticals.Build experiments around how models understand emotion, behavior and longitudinal human context.Prototype and ship full-stack AI products from idea through production.Evaluate frontier foundation models, multimodal models and emerging AI infrastructure.Build agentic systems that reason across conversations, structured information and external tools.Develop evaluation frameworks for measuring emotional and contextual understanding.Explore fine-tuning, representation learning, embeddings and domain-specific model adaptation.Work with large conversational and emotional datasets.Work directly with partners to deeply understand workflows and translate ambiguous problems into products.Move rapidly from research prototype user feedback production. What were looking for Were looking for an unusually strong generalist engineer with deep curiosity about AI. You should be able to move comfortably between research and engineering. You dont need someone else to translate a paper into an experiment or an experiment into a product. We value: Exceptional technical foundations. Strong computer science fundamentals and the ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, infrastructure and ML systems. Deep AI fluency. You actively follow frontier models, papers and tooling. When something important ships, you want to understand how it works, test it and determine whether it changes what we can build. Strong product instincts. You care about the human problem rather than simply completing a specification. Excellent communication. You can speak directly with partners, ask good questions, understand complex workflows and turn those conversations into technical decisions. High agency. You are comfortable being given an outcome rather than a ticket. Intellectual curiosity. You are interested not only in making models work, but understanding why they work and where they fail. We have a strong preference for candidates from top-tier engineering and research universities in India or globally, or candidates who can demonstrate an equivalent level of technical ability through exceptional research, open-source work or products they have built. Major plus Experience developing or training models from scratch. We are particularly interested in candidates who have gone deeper than simply calling foundation-model APIs. Experience with any of the following is valuable: PyTorch / JAXLLM training, fine-tuning and post-trainingMultimodal modelsSpeech and conversational intelligenceEmotion / affective computingRepresentation learningReinforcement learningModel evaluation and interpretabilityLarge-scale data pipelinesAgentic systems and tool useHuman-computer interactionComputational psychology or behavioral science You
